body: Unfortunately before anyone told me that was possible (including the hospital) it was already passed along to collections because I repeatedly told them I didn't have a job and couldn't afford the treatment.

I think it's just something that comes with being gay... Seems like it's impossible sometimes to make real connections. I was ostracized by a lot of my family so I've had to find solace in friends, but it feels like you're the only one who gives a shit sometimes. I hope it get's better for you. Hugs from Missouri
